topics.title: EDUDELIGHT GROUP OF SCHOOLS
topics.content:
EDUDELIGHT GROUP OF SCHOOLS
1 BENSON AVENUE, LEKKI PHASE 1, LAGOS
STATE.
FIRST
TERM EXAMINATION 2019/2020 SESSION
SUBJECT: BASIC TECHNOLOGY                                                 CLASS:  J.S.S 1
- A major property which distinguishes
ceramics from wood, metal, plastic and rubber is being (a) A good conductor (b)
brittle (c) resistance to corrosion (d) a poor conductor.
- Which of the following properties makes
glass suitable for the manufacture of eye glasses (a) brightness  (b) resistance to corrosion  (c) transparency  (d) resistance to heat
- The purest form of iron in commercial use
is ________(a) wrought iron  (b) pig
iron  (c) cast iron  (d) mild steel
- ________is an example of soft wood  (a) obeche
(b) opepe  (c) mahogany  (d)cedar
- ________is not a workshop safety
device  (a) goggles  (b) overall
(c) fire alarm  (d) towel
- Which of the following is not a product of
technology?  (a0 entertainment  (b) transportation  (c)clothes
(d) noise
- The property of metal which allows metal
to withstand physical shocks without bending is ______(a) toughness  (b) density
(c) malleability  (d) ductility
- ___________is an example of ferrous
metal  (a) copper  (b) bronze
(c) brass  (d) tool steel
- The following are properties of hardwood
except ______(a) it is dark in colour
(b) their leaves does not shed
(c) it is heavy  (d) it has annual
rings
- Which of these is not a safety guideline
for cyclists  (a) stay away from a car’s
lane  (b) obey zebra crossing  (c) do not eat while riding  (d) obey traffic light
- Which of the following protects the
clothes from dirt in the workshop?  (a)
gloves  (b)wrapper  (c) visors
(d) overall
- High level technology includes the
following except ________(a) aircraft
(b) dye crafts  (c)satellite  (d) submarine
- All these are examples of accidents caused
by “unsafe actions” except _________(a) absence of safety devices  (b) failure to use safety devices  (c) slippery floor  (d) working while sick.
- An ore is made up of non-metallic compounds
called  _________(a) gangue  (b) iron
(c) blasts  (d)crude
- ______is not a property of metal  (a) conductivity  (b) sonorous sound  (c)luster                                   (d)
reformability
- Shoes protect the ________against injury
- Metals are said to be ferious when it
___________other magnets
- Non-ferious metals do not contain iron
____________________
- Accidents may occur as a result of
____________________________ and
- ____________________________
Theory (Answer any
four)
1a.       List five safety devices
b.         Explain any two workshop safety device
c.         Define “TECHNOLOGY”
d.         List five (5) products of high level
technology.
2a.       Give “Two” differences between “FERROUS”
and NON-FERROUS” metals.
b.         List five (5) examples of “non-ferrous”
metals.
c.         Define “ACCIDENT”
d.         Give “4” properties of metals.
3a.       Define the following terms
(i)         Malleability
(ii)        Toughness
(iii)       Ductility
b,         Give 4 properties of hard wood.
c.         Define “TIMBER”
d.         List 3 types of softwood
4a.       Give 5 safety procedures for
“PEDESTRIANS”
b.         Define “ORES”
c.         Give four ways of preventing Accident
in the workshop.
5a.       Define “UNSAFE ACTION” as related to
workshop accident.
b.         Give four (4) examples of unsafe
condition of a workshop.
c.         Explain the term “CORROSION of METALS
d.         List “3” countries that are
“TECHNOLOGICALLY ADVANCED”

topics.title: EDUDELIGHT SECONDARY SCHOOL
topics.content:
EDUDELIGHT SECONDARY SCHOOL
1 BENSON AVENUE, LEKKI
PHASE 1, LAGOS.
MOCK EXAMINATION 2019/2020 SESSION
SUBJECT: BASIC TECHNOLOGY CLASS: JSS 3       TIME: 2 HOURS
OBJECIVE
- Which of the following is NOT a reason for drying wood? (a)It makes wood
more durable (b) It makes wood take paint.(c)It increases the weight of the
wood. (d)It makes wood stronger.
- The
purpose of installing overhead water tank in a building is (a) to prevent dirt
from entering the tank (b) to allow rainfall into the tank (c) for even flow of
water in the building (d) to increase the pressure of the water
- What is the power consumed by an electric iron which has resistance of 5¤ and current of 4amps? (a) 60watts (b) 40 watts (c)
80watts (d) 20watts
- How many teeth does gear B have if gear A has 80teeth
and rotates 20 times while gear B turns 40 times? (a) 160 teeth (b) 40 teeth
(c) 30 teeth (d) 10 teeth
- Natural rubber is made from a milky liquid called (a)
latex (b) moisture (c) solution (d) plasticiser
- Which of the following pencils is not ideal for
technical drawing? (a) 2B (b) 2H (c) 2C (d)HB
- The process of sawing a log of wood into marketable sizes
is called………(a)Felling (b)Wood coating (c)Seasoning (d)Sawing
- Heat energy can be converted directly to electrical
energy by the use of (a) windmill (b) thermocouple (c) water heater (d)
electric iron
- A plane is a woodwork tool used for (a) cutting (b)
clamping (c) joining (d) smoothing
- The composition of brass is (a) copper + tin (b)
phosphorus + tin (c) copper + zinc (d) zinc + aluminium
- The bonding agent in concrete is (a) mortar (b) gravel
(c) cement (d) water
- The following are methods of processing plastic except
(a) compression moulding (b) calendaring (c) extrusion (d) thermosetting
- Two purposes for which transformer can be used for are
to (a) step up and step down frequency (b) step up and step down resistance (c)
step up and step down voltage (d) step up and step down power
- The symbol shown below is
(a) Transformer (b)
inductor (c) resistor (d) capacitor
- The melting temperature of cast iron work is  (a) 1,0210 (b) 1,0520
(c) 1,2400 (d) 1,3210
- Which of the following is not likely to work with a
photoelectric device? (a) electric iron (b) calculator (c) door bell (d)
burglar alarm
- The liquid solution in secondary cell that produces
current is called (a) conductor (b) electrolyte (c) electrolysis (d) mercury
- Which of the following machines does not make use of
belt drives? (a) cassette player (b) sewing machine (c) bicycles (d) grinding
machine
- Which of these devices is used on sprocket? (a) chain
(b) belt (c) gear (d) clutch
- The most commonly used refrigerant is (a) ammonia (b)
ethyl-chloride (c) alcohol (d) Freon
- A solid structure in which a lot of heat energy is
generated to produce metal is called (a) oven (b) furnace (c) engineering block
(d) bakery
- Energy from water is known as (a) wave (b) hydro (c)
electricity (d) tidal
- Rice, corn, millet are best stored in (a) basket (b)
bags (c) barns (d) silos
- Which of the following is used for lubricating rollers
and bearings? (a) grease (b) kerosene (c) oil (d) water
- Wattmeter is an electrical instrument that measures
(a) electromotive force (b) potential difference (c) power (d) resistance
- Which of the following components of an electric
circuit stores energy in its electric field? (a) capacitor (b) electrolyte (c)
generator (d) resistor
- What type of energy is contained in food? (a) chemical
(b) electrical (c) kinetic (d) mechanical
- Calculate the gear ratio of a driving and a driven
gear of 15 and 60 teeth respectively (a) 1:3 (b) 1:4 (c) 4:1 (d) 2:3
- Which of these parts of vehicle does not require
friction? (a) brake (b) clutch (c) crank shaft (d) fan belt
- The type of flow in which the particles of water move
randomly is known as (a) turbulent flow (b) laminar flow (c)streamline flow (d)
speed flow
- The main purpose of machine is to - production
(a) estimate (b) improve (c) increase cost of (d) reduce
- Which of these is not a woodwork joint? (a) butt joint
(b) bridle joint (c) band joint (d) dovetail joint
- Rubber is an organic material that is highly (a)
brittle (b) permeable (c) tough (d) elastic
- Marine engineer designs and maintains a (a) ship (b)
car (c) aircraft (d) train
- The materials used for building foundation consists of
(a) cement + sand + water (b) cement + gravel +water (c) cement + sand + gravel
(d) cement + sand + gravel + water
- Which of the following is not an effect of friction? (a)
it slows down motion (b) it causes wear (c) it increases speed (d) it causes
heat
- A capacitor is a device used to (a) release electric
charge (b) store electric charge (c) increase electric charge (d) reduce
electric charge
- The electricity voltage supplied to our homes by PHCN
is in the range of (a) 220-240volts (b) 110-150volts (c) 100-200volts  (d) 50-60volts
- The
following are components of refrigerator except (a) evaporator (b) transformer
(c) condenser (d) compressor
- Which of these drawing pencils is the softest? (a) 2H
(b) 3H (c) 2B (d) HB
- The beam supporting a wall over an opening of
relatively short span is called (a) column (b) pillar (c) lintel (d) arc beam
- The process of splitting logs of wood into marketable
sizes is called (a) felling (b) conversion (c) seasoning (d) preservation
- Which of the following is not a permanent way of
joining metal (a) riveting (b) bolt and nut (c) welding (d) brazing
- In which of these would you store a large quantity of
shelled maize? (a) silos (b) cribs (c) earthen pots (d) barns
- Which of the following statements is not true of
secondary cell? (a) it is rechargeable (b) it produces current (c) it is not
dischargeable (d) it functions with acid
- To prevent electric shock, one of the following is
recommended (a) leather gloves (b) rubber gloves (c) cotton gloves (d) plastic
gloves
- Which of these furnaces is used for processing
stainless steel? (a) Bessemer converter (b) blast furnace (c) electric arc
furnace (d) reverberating furnace
- A device that makes different parts of a machine move
at different speeds or in different directions is the (a) camshaft (b) crank
(c) rack (d) gear
- The process of reducing moisture content in a timber
is called (a) maintenance (b) conversion (c) seasoning (d) drying
- Irregular lines and curves are drawn with (a) compass
(b) French curves (c) protractor (d) ruler
- Current is measured in (a) watts (b) amperes (c) volts
(d) joules
- Which of these devices is used on sprockets? (a) chain
(b) belt (c) gear (d) clutch
- A concrete cast at the point of use is known as (a)
cast in site (b) precast (c) foundation (d) column
- The liquid solution in secondary cell that produces
current is called (a) conductor (b) electrolyte (c) electrolysis (d) conductor
- All the following are rubber processing methods except
(a) extrusion (b) vacuum forming (c) calendaring (d) injection
- Which of the following is not a hardwood? (a) obeche
(b) mahogany (c) pine (d) teak
- The force applied to make a machine work is called (a)
mechanical advantage (b) effort (c) energy (d) fulcrum
- The following are properties of metal except (a)
density (b) colour (c) elasticity (d) malleability
- Electrical power consumed in the house is measured
with (a) voltmeter (b) watt-hour meter (c) Ammeter (d) ohmmeter
- Which of these materials is harvested? (a) rubber (b)
timber (c) plastic (d) metal
THEORY
Answer any four from the
seven questions.
- (a) Define transformer
(b) Draw the
symbol/conventions of the following
i. Inductor. ii.
Transformer iii. Cell iv. Capacitor
- (a) What is the current flowing in a circuit which has
two resistors of 4ohms each, connected in parallel to a power source of 24volts
(b) Define the following
building terms
i. Lintel( (ii) Bonding
(iii) Setting-out (iv) foundation
- (a) List three types of doors
(b) List three types of
roofs
(c) Name four effects of
friction
- (a) State the uses of the following drawing
instruments
(i) scale rule (ii)
divider (iii) French curve
(b) Circumscribe a circle
on a triangle with side AB=50mm, AC=50mm and BC=50mm
(c) What is the name of
triangle constructed above?
(d) Divide line AB=70mm
into 6 equal parts
- (a) Mention two advantages of friction
(b) Name and explain
three causes of friction
(c) State two laws of
friction
- (a) List three drive mechanisms in transmission of
mechanical energy
(b) Define pneumatic and
state three places where it can be applied
(c) Name three types of
gear and explain.
7.If a sample of wood
weighs 100grams before and 60 grams after drying. Calculate the percentage
moisture content of the sample of wood.
